subtitle: Lesson 26 · Security Administration with T-SQL

code:
SELECT
    dp.name AS orphaned_user,
    dp.sid
FROM sys.database_principals dp
WHERE dp.type IN ('S', 'U')
  AND dp.sid IS NOT NULL
  AND dp.name NOT IN ('guest', 'dbo', 'INFORMATION_SCHEMA', 'sys')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM sys.server_principals sp
      WHERE sp.sid = dp.sid
  );
caption: Every user whose sid has no match in sys.server_principals is orphaned.
